answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 4098 Country: India Title: I want to do fasting on every Friday as due to health problem I left some in Ramdan, can I miss the sahayri as I want to get up only for Fajar because there will be a lot of time from saharyi to Fajr. Question: I want to do fasting on every Friday as due to health problem I left some in Ramdan, can I miss the sahayri as I want to get up only for Fajar because there will be a lot of time from saharyi to Fajr. Answer ID: 4098 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 209/209=M) To have Sahri (meal before daybreak) is sunnah and a matter of reward and blessing, it supplies strength to the body for keeping fast. It has been encouraged in Hadith to eat Sahri . Now it is up to you whether achieve this reward or forsake it, the Shariah puts no pressure. However, keeping fast without having Sahri is valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
